verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI explicitly advertises debugging/troubleshooting via natural language (gh-3, gh-12/21, docs-3 'fixing bugs') and some users report positive agentic debugging experiences (comm-1, comm-5, comm-11). However, hands-on reports concretely contradict this: users describe it hallucinating and destructively deleting files during a task (comm-16), getting 'stuck in the middle of spaghetti code' with no plan mode (comm-15), being slow/confused navigating codebases (comm-13), and generally weak at complex coding/debugging tasks vs competitors (comm-12). missing for 10: consistent reliability evidence, resolution of destructive-behavior reports, first-party debugging-specific benchmarks.
